summary_en: Do not throw it in any bin. Bring it to an e-waste collection point.
hazard_en: Electronics contain lead, mercury and other toxic parts, and many have batteries inside.
fact_en: Electronics contain metals and chemicals that are harmful but valuable to recover.

summary_en: Bring it to a cartridge take-back or e-waste collection point.
hazard_en: Ink and toner can stain and irritate skin and eyes. Cartridges are e-waste.
fact_en: Ink and electronics in cartridges are harmful in regular waste.
